read: Strategic M&A is back at scale. Sanofi's $41bn cash bid for Insmed, announced this morning, is the largest biopharma deal in years and buys a de-risked, growing respiratory franchise rather than pipeline optionality. Monday was a clean-data day: the FDA approved Roche's Wilserdly in adjuvant breast cancer a week early, BridgeBio's Welgemda four days early, Novartis showed Leqvio cuts MACE in ORION-4, and Kymera's oral STAT6 degrader produced Dupixent-like Phase 2b numbers (+30%, then a reported ~$1.5bn raise into strength). Read with last week's Capricor and ivonescimab CRLs, the FDA is moving fast on clean randomized datasets and holding the line on weaker ones. Capital is flowing to oral I&I, cardiometabolic outcomes and late-stage respiratory/rare disease; IO add-ons in pancreatic cancer (Arcus PRISM-1) remain a graveyard. Tone is risk-on for quality; the China-policy overhang got another push from a House committee report.

items.headline: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed for ~$41bn in cash ($175/share)
items.detail: 46% premium to the unaffected 18 Nov close and ~17.5% to Monday's $149.09. Adds Brinsupri (brensocatib, NCFB), Arikayce and Phase 3 TPIP; funded with debt and cash, accretive to business EPS by end-2028, close expected 1H27, no change to 2026 guidance. The biggest move yet under CEO Belén Garijo, and a large bet on respiratory beyond Dupixent.

items.headline: Roche: FDA approves Wilserdly (giredestrant) as adjuvant monotherapy in ER+/HER2- stage I-III breast cancer
items.detail: Approved a week before the 30 Nov PDUFA and a week after the ESR1m metastatic nod. lidERA (4,100+ pts) cut iDFS-event risk 30% vs standard endocrine therapy (140 vs 196 events); AE discontinuations 5.3% vs 8.2%. First SERD in early disease, the setting Roche says holds ~70% of the opportunity; puts it ahead of AstraZeneca's Etcamah (camizestrant) and Lilly's Inluriyo, which are metastatic-only.

items.headline: Novartis: Leqvio (inclisiran) meets primary MACE endpoint in Phase 3 ORION-4 (established ASCVD)
items.detail: ~16,100 patients; first CV outcomes win for an siRNA. No HR disclosed; full data 1H27. Removes Leqvio's main commercial objection vs Amgen's Repatha, supports Alnylam (licensor) and sets the bar for Merck's oral PCSK9 enlicitide.

items.headline: Kymera: oral STAT6 degrader KT-621 hits all endpoints in Phase 2b BROADEN2 (atopic dermatitis); KYMR +30%
items.detail: n=244, week 16, mid dose: EASI -72% vs -27% placebo; EASI-75 62% vs 22%; vIGA 0/1 38% vs 11%; separation from week 1; conjunctivitis mild/moderate, no AE discontinuations. Closed $150.37 (record high), then reportedly launched a ~$1.5bn offering. Phase 3 by mid-2027; asthma Phase 2b late 2027. First oral to approach Dupixent-level efficacy, a direct long-term threat to Sanofi/Regeneron.

items.headline: Arcus: Phase 3 PRISM-1 (quemliclustat + gem/nab-pac, 1L metastatic PDAC) stopped at interim OS
items.detail: ~650 pts, 2:1; efficacy similar to chemo alone on primary and secondary endpoints. RCUS recovered to ~+5% intraday because the value sits in casdatifan (HIF-2a); Wedbush ascribed nothing to quemliclustat. Gilead opted in in 2021 but left the trial to Arcus. Effectively ends CD73 in PDAC.

items.headline: BridgeBio: FDA grants full approval to Welgemda (BBP-418, ribitol), first therapy for LGMD2I/R9
items.detail: Four days early. FORTIFY: +0.27 m/s on 100MTT vs placebo, ~5% FVC benefit; PRV granted; BBIO +4%. Second commercial product after Attruby; Jefferies previously modelled $1bn+ peak. Pressure on Sarepta's SRP-9003 gene therapy in the same indication.

items.headline: Lilly acquires LoQus23 (Cambridge, UK) for up to $725m
items.detail: Undisclosed upfront. Preclinical oral MSH3 inhibitor LQT-23 to block somatic CAG expansion in Huntington's; CTA by year-end. Lilly's first Huntington's move and its second M&A deal this month; an exit for SV Health's DDF, Forbion and Novartis Venture Fund. Somatic-expansion modifiers are the next wave after uniQure's AMT-130 (under BLA review).

items.headline: Ritzey Therapeutics launches with $112.5m Series A (Intra-Cellular founder Sharon Mates)
items.detail: Led by Vida Ventures, with EcoR1, Fidelity, Perceptive and others. Bought France's Perha for an oral DYRK1A inhibitor that has finished Phase 1, heading into Phase 2 in Down syndrome and T1D/T2D. No human data disclosed yet.

items.headline: Policy: House China Select Committee issues final US-China biotech report
items.detail: Recommends BINSA passage plus 11 further policies, including limits on FDA reliance on certain data and clinical-trial reforms. Adds to the overhang on the China in-licensing trade alongside Treasury's draft outbound-investment rules.

items.headline: Invivyd: VYD2311 (Pemgarda successor) shows Phase 3 promise; BLA targeted Q1 2027
items.detail: Accelerated-approval path on DECLARATION plus LIBERTY data; IVVD +17% premarket.

items.headline: Beam: risto-cel BLA in sickle cell expected in December
items.detail: Approval ~3Q27 with priority review, else Dec 2027; BEAM-302 (AATD) pivotal cohort fully dosed 1H27.

items.headline: Sinotau Pharma (radiopharma) falls ~15% on Hong Kong debut
items.detail: Priced at the HK$52 low end (HK$276.6m net) despite >5,200x retail oversubscription.

items.headline: Astromech buys Form Bio in an all-stock deal valued at $230m
items.detail: AI genetic-medicine vector design, in the Colossal orbit.

items.headline: IQVIA acquires Quotient Sciences from Permira
FDA: eases REMS for three IMiDs and will add accelerated-approval status to patient labeling
items.detail: Burden reduction for lenalidomide/pomalidomide/thalidomide programmes (BMS legacy franchises).
